title: 第34章 碎了老糙汉的心
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 范金花一走，整个张家就被抽走了主心骨，瞬间就塌了。家里两个男人此起彼伏的呻吟声，跟二重唱似的，一声比一声凄厉。“哎哟……我的腰……断了……”“疼……疼死我了……妈……妈！”徐喜弟站在堂屋中间，听着这两股声音，只觉得脑袋里嗡嗡作响，像有无数只苍蝇在飞。她能怎么办？猪圈里的猪饿得嗷嗷叫，那声音比屋里两个男人的叫唤还实在。她叹了口气，认命地走进火房，往灶里添柴，煮猪食。一瓢一瓢的猪菜倒进大锅，搅动起来，热气熏得她满脸是汗。这个家，离了谁都得转，可要是离了她，这锅猪食都没人煮。好不容易把猪喂完，她才端了碗稀粥，先走进张国海的屋。张国海趴在床上，脸埋在枕头里，还在哼哼唧唧。“爸，起来吃点东西吧。”徐喜弟把碗放在床头的小凳上。张国海慢吞吞地转过头，一双浑浊的眼睛里全是怨毒。“吃什么吃！人都快死了，还吃什么！”他一开口，全是火药味。“那个死婆娘呢？”“妈回娘家找郎中寻药去了。”徐喜弟一边回答，一边把勺子递过去。“不用你伺候！”张国海一把挥开她的手，碗里的粥洒了大半。“帮我寻药？她这是回娘家躲闲去了！好得很！你们都巴不得我死是吧？”“我告诉你们，我死不了！我就要拖着，看你们谁先熬不住！”徐喜弟看着洒了一地的粥，胸口堵得慌，一口气差点没上来。她什么也没说，弯腰把碗捡起来，转身就出了屋。怕再待下去，自己会忍不住把那半碗粥扣他脑袋上。深吸几口气，她又端了一碗，走向张永福的屋。这才是真正的地狱。刚一推开门，张永福的呻吟声就停了。他躺在床上，一双眼睛阴恻恻地盯着她。“你还知道来？”他声音沙哑，带着一丝病态的笑意。从上次她把他甩地上后，他就再也没见过她。今天老爹闪了腰不能伺候他，所以她终于出现了。很好！“吃饭了。”徐喜弟把碗放在床边，不敢靠得太近。“我手疼，脚也疼，全身都疼。你喂我。”张永福命令道。徐喜弟捏了捏拳头，还是端起碗，舀了一勺粥，小心翼翼地递到他嘴边。张永福没张嘴，眼睛却死死地盯着她的肚子。“你过来点，我够不到。”徐喜弟只好又往前挪了半步，几乎就贴在床沿上了。就在她把勺子再次递过去的时候，张永福突然暴起！他那只看似无力的手，闪电般伸出来，不是去接勺子，而是死死地抓住了她的手腕。另一只手，握成拳头，用尽全身的力气，狠狠地朝着她的肚子捶了下去！“贱人！你敢怀野种！我让你怀！”咚！一拳结结实实地砸在小腹上。徐喜弟疼得闷哼一声，整个人都懵了，手里的碗哐当一声掉在地上，摔得粉碎。“你敢生一个，我就捶死一个！生两个，我捶死一双！”张永福的脸因为用力而扭曲，状若疯魔。他抓着徐喜弟不放，拳头雨点般落下，每一拳都对准了她的肚子。“我弄不死那个奸夫，我还弄不死你肚子里的孽种吗？！”徐喜弟终于反应过来，用力挣扎。她另一只手去推张永福的头，可他像疯了一样，死死地缠着她，咬着牙像极了地狱的恶鬼。“放开！你放开我！”她拼命地往后退，张永福半个身子都被她从床上拖了下来，可那只手还是像铁钳一样箍着她。巴儿姐被屋里的动静惊动，探头探脑地出现在门口，看到这一幕，吓得阿巴阿巴地叫唤，却不敢上前。徐喜弟怒极了，她用尽力气，猛地一掀，张永福敌不过，被翻回了床上。徐喜弟趁机挣脱出来，连滚带爬地跑出了屋子。她一口气跑到院门口，扶着被刘烨新修好的竹门，大口大口地喘气。最后靠着门柱，缓缓地滑坐到地上。完了。这个家，真的完了。婆婆走了，公公瘫了，丈夫疯了。她该怎么办？她能逃到哪里去？十八年了，她在这个家里，像一头被拴住的牲口。她以为只要再熬一熬，等怀了孩子，给张家留个后，就能摆脱这里。可现在她才明白，这里是深渊，将她牢牢缠住的无底深渊。眼泪，就这么毫无征兆地涌了出来。起先只是无声地流，后来，她再也忍不住，把脸埋在膝盖里呜呜哭了出来。……刘烨扛着锄头回村。他其实已经带了饭的，可心里总觉得不安，还是决定回家看看。刚进村，老远就看到徐喜弟坐在院门口。他加快脚步，往张家走。等他走近，就听见徐喜弟在那里呜呜地哭。那张总平日是憨憨笑着的脸，此刻一点笑意都没有了。他眉头紧紧地拧在一起，心疼极了。徐喜弟从来就没哭过。不管是被范金花骂，还是被张永福折腾，她总是低着头，默默地承受。今天这是怎么了？他慢慢走上前，高大的身影替她挡住了正午毒辣的太阳。徐喜弟感觉眼前一暗，哭声渐渐小了。她抬起头，一张哭得通红的脸，眼睛肿得像桃子，泪水还挂在睫毛上。看到是刘烨，她先愣了一下，然后万分委屈地叫了一声，“叔。”这一声叫唤，彻底把他这个老糙汉的心叫碎了。“咋了？家里出什么事了？”刘烨蹲下身，声音有些笨拙，又有些小心翼翼。徐喜弟不说话，只是吸着鼻子。“谁欺负你了？”他又问。徐喜弟摇摇头，她总不能说，张永福不让她生傻叔的孩子吧？刘烨看着她，心里又急又疼。他知道，肯定是张家那两个不是东西的男人做了什么。他站起身，二话不说，转身就要往院里走。“叔！”徐喜弟拉住了他的裤腿，声音带着浓浓的鼻音和哭腔，“别去……”
content_en: As soon as Fan Jinhua left, the entire Zhang family was stripped of its backbone and collapsed in an instant.The two men in the house moaned one after another, like a duet, each one louder than the other."Ouch... my waist... is broken..." "It hurts... it hurts me so much... Mom... Mom!" Xu Xidi stood in the middle of the hall, listening to these two sounds, he felt like there was a buzzing in his head, like countless flies flying.What can she do?The pigs in the pigsty howled with hunger, and the sound was more real than the screams of the two men in the room.She sighed and walked into the fire room resignedly, adding firewood to the stove and cooking pig food.Ladle after ladle of pork vegetables was poured into the cauldron and stirred. The heat made her face covered with sweat.In this family, everyone has to move around if they leave her, but if she leaves, there will be no one to cook the pot of pig food.After finally finishing feeding the pigs, she took a bowl of gruel and walked into Zhang Guohai's house first.Zhang Guohai was lying on the bed, his face buried in the pillow, still moaning."Dad, get up and have something to eat." Xu Xidi put the bowl on the small stool beside the bed.Zhang Guohai slowly turned his head, his cloudy eyes full of resentment."Eat what you want! People are dying, why should we eat!" When he opened his mouth, it smelled like gunpowder."Where's that dead mother-in-law?" "Mom went back to her parents' house to look for medicine from the doctor." Xu Xidi answered, handing over the spoon."You don't need to wait on me!" Zhang Guohai waved her hand away, spilling most of the porridge in the bowl."Help me find medicine? She has gone back to her parents' home to take some time off! It's great! You all want me to die, right?" "I'm telling you, I can't die! I'm going to drag it on to see who of you can't stand it first!" Xu Xidi looked at the porridge spilled on the floor, his chest was so tight that he almost couldn't breathe.She said nothing, bent down to pick up the bowl, turned around and left the room.He was afraid that if he stayed any longer, he would not be able to help but put the half bowl of porridge on his head.After taking a few deep breaths, she took another bowl and walked towards Zhang Yongfu's house.This is the real hell.As soon as he opened the door, Zhang Yongfu's moaning stopped.He was lying on the bed, staring at her with a pair of eyes."You still know how to come?" His voice was hoarse, with a sickly smile.He hadn't seen her since the last time she threw him to the ground.Today my father was too busy to serve him, so she finally showed up.very good!"It's time to eat." Xu Xidi put the bowl next to the bed, not daring to get too close."My hands hurt, my feet hurt, and my whole body hurts. Feed me." Zhang Yongfu ordered.Xu Xidi clenched his fists, then picked up the bowl, scooped out a spoonful of porridge, and carefully handed it to his mouth.Zhang Yongfu didn't open his mouth, but his eyes were fixed on her belly."Come here, I can't reach it." Xu Xidi had no choice but to move forward half a step, almost touching the edge of the bed.Just when she handed the spoon over again, Zhang Yongfu suddenly burst out!His seemingly weak hand stretched out like lightning, not to pick up the spoon, but to firmly grab her wrist.With the other hand, he clenched it into a fist and used all his strength to punch her in the stomach!"Bitch! How dare you get pregnant with a bastard! I'll let you get pregnant!" Boom!A solid punch hit his lower abdomen.Xu Xidi grunted in pain and was stunned. The bowl in his hand fell to the ground with a clang and shattered into pieces."If you dare to give birth to one child, I will beat one to death! If you give birth to two children, I will beat both of them to death!" Zhang Yongfu's face was twisted with force, as if he was crazy.He held on to Xu Xidi, and his fists fell like raindrops, each punch aimed at her stomach."If I can't kill that adulterer, can't I kill the evil seed in your belly?!" Xu Xidi finally came to his senses and struggled hard.She used her other hand to push Zhang Yongfu's head, but he was clinging to her like crazy, gritting his teeth like a demon from hell."Let go! Let me go!" She stepped back desperately, and half of Zhang Yongfu's body was dragged off the bed by her, but his hand was still holding her like an iron clamp.Sister Ba'er was alerted by the movement in the house and appeared at the door with her head peeping out. When she saw this scene, she was so frightened that she screamed, but she didn't dare to come forward.Xu Xidi was so angry that she tried her best to lift him up, but Zhang Yongfu couldn't resist and was turned back to the bed.Xu Xidi took the opportunity to break free and ran out of the house crawling on the ground.She ran to the courtyard door in one breath, held on to the bamboo door newly repaired by Liu Ye, and gasped for air.Finally, he leaned against the doorpost and slowly slid to the ground.It's over.This home is really finished.My mother-in-law is gone, my father-in-law is paralyzed, and my husband is crazy.What should she do?Where could she escape to?For eighteen years, she has been like a tethered animal in this family.She thought that as long as she endured it a little longer, she would be able to get out of here after she was pregnant with a child and give it to the Zhang family.But now she realized that this was an abyss, a bottomless abyss that tightly entangled her.Tears just burst out without any warning.At first it just flowed silently, but later, she couldn't help it anymore, buried her face in her knees and cried....Liu Ye returned to the village carrying a hoe.He had actually brought food, but he still felt uneasy, so he decided to go home and take a look.As soon as I entered the village, I saw Xu Xidi sitting at the entrance of the courtyard from a distance.He quickened his pace and walked towards Zhang's house.When he got closer, he heard Xu Xidi crying there.The face that usually smiled innocently had no smile at all now.His brows knit together tightly, feeling extremely distressed.Xu Xidi has never cried.Whether she was scolded by Fan Jinhua or tormented by Zhang Yongfu, she always lowered her head and endured it silently.What happened today?He walked forward slowly, his tall figure blocking her from the scorching midday sun.Xu Xidi felt his eyes darken, and his crying gradually became smaller.She raised her head, her face red from crying, her eyes swollen like peaches, and tears still hanging on her eyelashes.Seeing that it was Liu Ye, she was stunned for a moment, and then called out in great grievance, "Uncle." This call completely broke the heart of this old rough man."What's wrong? What happened at home?" Liu Ye squatted down, his voice a little awkward and cautious.Xu Xidi didn't speak, just sniffed."Who bullied you?" he asked again.Xu Xidi shook her head. She couldn't say that Zhang Yongfu wouldn't let her have Uncle Silly's child, right?Liu Ye looked at her, feeling anxious and painful.He knew that it must have been the two men from the Zhang family who had done something.He stood up, turned around and walked into the courtyard without saying a word."Uncle!" Xu Xidi pulled his trouser leg, his voice had a strong nasal sound and a crying tone, "Don't go..."
